name: Unpolished
source:
Unpolished is a short, non-branching visual novel. It is best read with an open mind as an abstract piece. Unpolished uses filtered photographs and a minimalistic presentation style to tell a universal story that is meant to speak to the hearts of readers of any age. 

The story is set inside an auditorium in the middle of an impromptu speaking contest.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=7816]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]

Released as part of the [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140912173620/http://teacup.lunaen.com/index.php?topic=29.0]Teacup VN Festival 2010[/url].
